description: The agent-CLI customManager that used to live here has been removed (Factory#90). It claimed to track @anthropic-ai/claude-code, @openai/codex and @google/gemini-cli and to open a weekly grouped bump PR that the cli-canary would gate. It did neither, for two independent reasons.

First, its fileMatch pointed at apps/{aifactory,pfactory,tfactory}/manifests/manifests.yaml, and TFactory#791 moved the pins out of those files into the service repos' Dockerfiles. It has matched nothing since.

Second, and true from the day it was written: the Renovate GitHub App is not installed on this account. There are zero Renovate PRs across all five Factory repos and no Dependency Dashboard issue despite config:recommended. See the AIFactory and TFactory .github/dependabot.yml headers, which record the same discovery for base images.

NOT COVERED, stated rather than implied. Nothing proposes bumps for the three agent CLIs. Dependabot's docker ecosystem parses only FROM lines, so it cannot see the `npm install -g @pkg@version` bake step that now holds them. .github/workflows/cli-canary.yml runs weekly and catches a yanked or broken pin, and catches the three Dockerfiles drifting apart, but it will not tell you a newer version exists. Remediation belongs in each service repo, not here, because the pins are no longer in this repo at all.
